title: Restriction of the bare derived base-change arrow with natural target comparison
statement: Let f:X→S, f':X'→S', g:S'→S and g':X'→X form a cartesian square [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and K∈D(O_X). Let V⊆S, V'⊆S' with V'⊆g⁻¹V, U=f⁻¹V, U'=f'⁻¹V', and j:U'→U with j≫U.ι=U'.ι≫g', and suppose the restricted square is cartesian. Put K0=K|U, R=restriction from S' to V', R'=restriction from X' to U' [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let δ:L(j)*K0→R'(L(g')*K) be singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient for identity on L(g')*K [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data]. There exist an isomorphism a:R(Lg*Rf*K)≅L(g|V')*R(f|V)*K0 and a natural isomorphism b:(Rf'_* followed by R)≅(R' followed by R(f'|V')_*) such that R(baseChange(K))=a.hom≫baseChange0(K0)≫R(f'|V')_*(δ)≫b.inv.app(L(g')*K) [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. There is no K', coefficient map or stalk-condition hypothesis.

theorem singleComplexOpen_baseChange_identity
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (j : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g')
    (sq₀ : IsPullback j (f' ∣_ V') (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V V' hV')) :
    let K₀ := (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K
    let R := (schemeOpenRestriction S' V').mapDerivedCategory
    let R' := (schemeOpenRestriction X' (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V')).mapDerivedCategory
    let δ := singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient g' K ((derivedPullback g').obj K) (𝟙 _)
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V') j hj
    ∃ (a : R.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj K)) ≅
          (derivedPullback (g.resLE V V' hV')).obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ V)).obj K₀))
      (b : schemeDerivedDirectImage f' ⋙ R ≅ R' ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage (f' ∣_ V')),
      R.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w K) =
        a.hom ≫ schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap
          (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀.w K₀ ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage (f' ∣_ V')).map δ ≫
          b.inv.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
